entry.title: New: Resolution 369 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE OFFICE OF HOUSING AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT TO AWARD FUNDS TO VARIOUS NONPROFIT ORGANIZATIONS FOR PROGRAMS ADDRESSING HOUSING AND HOMELESSNESS

Proposes 22 grant awards to 13 different nonprofit organizations for a total of $9,794,459.33 in funding that was derived from Tier Two property tax revenues.

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 369-23 & LAAC-45 - 12/20/23
